storyCards.headline: Free Fallin': The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Tom Petty's "Free Fallin'" reached #7 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Free Fallin' was released in 1989.
